name: quercus
systemHint: You have read-only UofT Quercus access through `quercus` (source at <exocortex-source-dir>/external-tools/quercus). Run `quercus -h`; prefer --json. Assignments include the user's submission state; check page prose as well as due-date metadata. Auth uses this machine's local vimbrowser, never another machine's. Renew an imported session with `quercus login --from-vimbrowser --tab ID` after authenticating that exact Quercus tab, or use --persistent for a dedicated renewable context. Never start/submit quizzes through this tool. Keep cookies private. Per-machine state paths come from the tool's untracked config/local.env; installing this tool creates no reminders.
